name: Expansion Capital
text: Choose a locked lot: it opens for free

name: Growth Investment
text: Choose a business: it gains +2 value permanently

name: New Hire
text: Roll 1 more die every quarter from next quarter on

name: Exclusive Deal
text: A rare business from the deck joins deal flow

name: Gold Pocket
text: Choose a lot: a business there earns double its value when it operates

name: Express Lane
text: Choose a lot: a business there can operate with any single die

name: Open Charter
text: Choose a restricted lot: it accepts any business

name: Gold Edition
text: Choose a business: it becomes Gold (earns double its value when it operates)

name: Holographic Edition
text: Choose a business: it becomes Holographic (its ability triggers twice)

name: Blue Chip Edition
text: Choose a business: it becomes Blue Chip (never distressed, can't be targeted)

name: Franchise Edition
text: Choose a business: it becomes a Franchise (counts as 2 of its sector)
